repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.subtitle: Hosted, proxy and group repositories for every supported format
repositories.emptyHint: Create a hosted repository to publish artifacts, or a proxy to cache a public registry.
repositories.standardHint: One click creates the usual proxy, hosted and group repositories for every installed format: the proxy of the public registry, a repository for your own packages and a group that joins both.

typeHints.HOSTED: Artifacts are uploaded by clients and stored here.
typeHints.PROXY: Artifacts are fetched from a remote registry on demand and cached.
typeHints.GROUP: Merges several repositories of the same format under one URL.

hints.name: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Becomes part of the URL and cannot be changed later.
hints.allowRedeploy: Allow overwriting an artifact that already exists.
hints.versionPolicy: Which kinds of versions this repository accepts.
hints.remoteUrl: Absolute http(s) URL of the upstream registry.
hints.remoteAuth: Only needed for private upstreams. Leave blank to keep the stored secret.
hints.remoteToken: Bearer token, used instead of username and password.
hints.timeouts: Leave blank to use the server defaults.
hints.metadataMaxAge: How long cached metadata (index files) stays fresh before it is re-checked upstream. 0 re-checks every time.
hints.negativeCache: How long an upstream 404 is remembered. 0 disables it.
hints.offlineMode: Serve cached content only; never contact the upstream.
hints.members: Ordered list: the first member that has an artifact wins.
hints.formatSettings: Settings specific to {format}. Leave a field blank to use the default.

members.noCandidates: There is no other {format} repository to add.

repositories.confirmDelete: Delete the repository “{name}”? All of its artifacts are removed. This cannot be undone.

repository.confirmDeleteComponent: Delete {name} {version} and all of its assets?

connect.title: Connect your tools
connect.intro: Use the snippets below to point your package manager at this repository. Replace the placeholders with your username and an API token from your account page.
connect.anonymousHint: Credentials are optional for downloads while anonymous access is enabled; they are always required for publishing.
connect.empty: This format has no ready-made snippets yet.
connect.emptyHint: Use the repository URL above in your client's configuration.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find components across the repositories you may read

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People who can sign in to Granary

hints.name: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Cannot be changed later.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your profile, password and API tokens

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens authenticate package managers and CI jobs without exposing your password. Use one as the password for Maven and NuGet, or as the _authToken for npm.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.expiresOptional: Leave blank for a token that never expires.
tokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke the token “{name}”? Clients using it stop working immediately.
tokens.secretHint: Copy it now. For security reasons it is shown only once and cannot be recovered later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Global behaviour of this server
settings.anonymousReadHint: Allow downloads from every repository without credentials. Uploads always need credentials. Turn this off on a shared network where artifacts are confidential.
settings.offlineModeHint: Stop every proxy repository from contacting its upstream. Cached artifacts are still served. Useful during an internet outage or on an air-gapped network.
settings.baseUrlHint: The URL under which clients reach this server, for example behind a reverse proxy. It is used for the repository URLs shown here and in generated metadata. Leave blank to derive it from each request.
